How the WhatsApp QR code works

The code stores a wa.me link, WhatsApp's click-to-chat address. Scanning it opens a WhatsApp chat with your number, and any message you added is ready to send. It works with both personal WhatsApp and WhatsApp Business.

The number must be registered on WhatsApp. This tool only builds the code and does not connect to your account.

How to create one

The main thing to get right is the number format.

  1. Write the number with the country code and digits only, with no plus sign, spaces or dashes. For a US number, 15551234567 means +1 555 123 4567.
  2. Optional: add a first message such as "Hi, I have a question about my order".
  3. Choose colors, add a logo or a frame, and download the PNG or SVG.
  4. Scan the code from another phone to confirm the chat opens with the right number.

Want a group or a channel instead?

For a WhatsApp group, copy the group invite link from the group settings and paste it into the main QR code generator as a link. The same works for a WhatsApp Channel link.

Tips

A few habits keep the chat useful.

  • Use a business number on public materials. A code on a poster can be scanned by anyone.
  • Set expectations. Add your reply hours next to the code.
  • Try WhatsApp Business for a business profile and quick replies.
  • Keep the code at least about 1 inch (2.5 cm) wide and test before printing.
